properties.field_evidence: Official Cherwell District Council Planning Register application 23/00871/F. Application Type: Full Development. Status: Application Permitted. Valid date: 30/03/2023. Location: Buildings To Rear Home Farm House Wigginton OX15 4JZ. Proposal: Change of Use and conversion of the disused barn and the reconstruction of the single storey range into a single residential dwelling; minor internal reconfiguration of the layout and windows; demolition of the existing garage and replacement with new 2.5 bay garage including a home office within the roof; reconstruction of the single storey range - in relation to 19/02695/F. Decision: Permitted. Decision Issued Date: 14/07/2023. Official proposed documents include AL 10 002 - D Proposed Site/Block Plan; AL 10 010 - D Proposed elevations (with garage); and AL 10 006 - A Proposed garage layouts and elevations. The official proposal explicitly identifies one new replacement 2.5 bay garage including a home office within the roof. Conversion/reconstruction works to the existing barn and single-storey range are not counted as additional distinct new structures. Geometry/materialization is deferred to local OpenCode.
